ranking is unstable and several models have correlated errors, so a weighted combination based on inverse error may help.
I will test a DBA combination, which is a different kind of strategy than mean or weighted.
test softmax weighting on full pool
test a robust median combination to see if it improves over mean, given trend dominance and unstable rankings.
test a weighted combination on the stable top-7 pool to see if restricting to low-error, less correlated models improves over mean.
test a weighted softmax combination on the reduced, diverse pool4 to see if per-horizon weighting helps in a trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
The series has unstable rankings and correlated errors; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting on the smaller, more diverse pool4 may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
I will test a per‑horizon weighted combination using the top‑k‑per‑horizon handle (w7) on the full model pool, to see if per‑horizon selection helps when rankings are unstable.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9372 and seasonal strength 0.1398; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.209); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.352.
